steps.note: The quark is left to lose its water.
The cheese is shaped into bars or hand-sized balls, each with an elderflower head stuck in so the mites can get inside.
The cheeses are left in a box with the mites and rye flour, which feeds them and keeps them from eating too much cheese.

sources.text: The steps from drained quark to mite-ripened Milbenkäse and the one to twelve months of ripening; the source gives no temperature or humidity.
